snippet.title: That's Not My Mom | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
This is an anomaly-finding horror game where you search for unusual occurrences around the house. You play as a young elementary school boy who encounters anomalies every time he returns home from school. His mother behaves suspiciously, and strange events seem to be spreading throughout the city. Your goal is to uncover the truth behind this anomaly outbreak.

This game is a small side project developed alongside our main title, Silent Still 3. Expect a simple story, modest visuals, and a focused anomaly-based horror experience.

Can you find all the anomalies, or will you be trapped with this entity in the house forever?

This game is inspired by Twisted Gallery and Exit 8. It's a short anomaly game and while it isn’t terrifying, it features a heavy atmosphere and plenty of scares.
